map.why: Where does a payment get recorded, and which store does the tab read?
map.title: Two stores, one tab
map.aria: The API writes receipts to Postgres; events would go to ClickHouse; the tab reads only ClickHouse.
map.caption: Red text: what crosses the wire. Dashed red: what never happens today. Illustrative values.

write.why: Which process writes a receipt row, and with which fields?
write.title: One charge, every field
write.aria: The shop app posts a charge, the API queues a receipt job, the worker inserts the row.
write.caption: Orange: the lines that decide whose receipt it is and why retries are safe. Illustrative values.

before.why: What does the tab do today?
before.title: Before: events only
before.aria: The tab reads events, gets zero rows and shows No receipts yet; the receipts table is never read.
before.caption: Red: the empty result. Grey: data that exists but is never read.

after.title: After: read the receipts table
after.aria: With no events, the tab calls a new receipts read on Postgres and shows three receipts.
after.caption: Green: new parts. Same grid as Before.
